acceptanceBoundaries: Selected native SDK workflows, not every method or overload; SDK command/reference tables define bounds.
Native GUI/LLDB and guarded live target writes accepted on macOS only; Windows/Linux lanes cover selected headless SDK/VT/FID/BSim workflows.
ProgramDiff is read-only categorized inspection; complex publication still requires an unchanged shared base.
VT association decisions and markup inspection precede ordinary explicit facade edits; no automatic markup publication.
FID/BSim use local actual native databases and native uncalibrated scores; no external service provisioning or statistical calibration.
Schedules are parsed/validated without execution; an uncertain live write never repeats.
The scale fixture is 32 MiB initialized memory, 20000 symbols and 1000 types; not a production capacity benchmark.
Remaining upstream algorithms retain explicit unbounded-work policies; extra kernels/calibration require a measured workload.
Historical P0/P1 and M0–M5 evidence remains bound to its original source. No npm publication or automatic publication strategy.
